rules.title: Substantial Rehabilitation Exemption from Rent Restrictions
rules.requirement: A dwelling that undergoes substantial rehabilitation costing more than 50% of its fair market value within a 12-month period, and receives a Certificate of Occupancy confirming the work, is exempt from rent control and the landlord may charge an unrestricted initial rent.
rules.key_value: Rehab cost must exceed 50% of fair market value; resulting initial rent is unrestricted

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to dwellings substantially reconstructed or rehabilitated where rehabilitation cost during a 12-month period exceeds 50% of the appraised fair market value of the property, and a Certificate of Occupancy or Temporary Certificate of Occupancy has been issued.

rules.exemptions: Exemption is lost for portions of the building not covered by a Temporary Certificate of Occupancy until a separate exemption application is approved; applications limited to a two-year window referenced elsewhere in the chapter.
rules.interaction: Works alongside the Vacant Properties exemption (§19:2-18.2); both are administered by the Rent Control Board under Title XIX, Chapter 2.
rules.quoted_span:
Substantially reconstructed or rehabilitated dwellings shall not be restricted in initial rent charged, if the Rent Control Board has made the following determinations: 
a. The Board shall determine that the cost of reconstruction or rehabilitation during a twelve-month period exceeds 50% of the fair market value of the property.
rules.conflict_note: Document does not restate the original effective date of this section; 2024-09-18 (adoption of Ordinance 6PSF-I, which this amends) is used as best available estimate.

rules.title: Vacant Properties Substantial Rehabilitation Petition and Unrestricted Initial Rent
rules.requirement: An owner of a vacant property that has been substantially rehabilitated may petition the Rent Control Board for an exemption allowing an unrestricted initial rent, supported by an appraisal, permits, a rehabilitation plan, and a Certificate of Occupancy, and must swear that prior tenants were not evicted in order to qualify.
rules.key_value: Initial rent unrestricted upon Board approval of a valid petition; appraisal must be completed within 90 days of start of construction

coverage_conditions.notes: Applies to vacant dwellings being substantially rehabilitated; requires appraisal, construction permits, rehabilitation plan (waived for buildings of 4 units or fewer), and a non-continued Certificate of Occupancy or Temporary Certificate of Occupancy.

rules.exemptions: Petition invalid without a bona fide Certificate of Occupancy; a continued Certificate of Occupancy does not qualify; separate applications required for portions of a building not covered by a Temporary Certificate of Occupancy; applications limited to a two-year window referenced in §19:2-18.2c.
rules.interaction: Parallels the Substantial Rehabilitation exemption under §19:2-18.3; both remove rent restrictions upon Board approval.
rules.quoted_span: The unrestricted initial rent that shall be charged shall appear on the petition, as well as a sworn and notarized affidavit executed by the landlord stating that he/she did not in any way, manner or method evict the prior tenants from the dwelling in question for the purpose of being considered under this section.
rules.conflict_note: Original effective date of this section not restated in this amendatory ordinance; 2024-09-18 used as best available estimate for the underlying chapter.
